v5.9.19 - Settings UI overhaul
Features --- - New Callout, Toast, DomainHeader, and SettingRow components across settings pages - Settings hub glass domain tiles; Training and Racing landing pages - Home RunPanel with run status indicator and cleaner layout - Parent Farming tabs (Setup | Automation | Tune) and shared TabStrip pickers - Debug page tabs (Tuning | Tools | Tests) - TabStrips on Training, Training Events, and Smart Race Solver settings - Global search navigation improvements for settings stack pages
Includes v5.9.18 parent farming reliability bundle.
